Mission.headline: Ka khubor ka ym kylla. Ka rukom ba ki briew ki peit, ka kylla.
Mission.intro: Ngi dang tei thymmai na ka nongrim ia ka thup video bad ki tiar jong ngi, ban buh ia ka kam jingkylla ktien jong bun phew snem ha ki jaka ba ki briew ki ïaïalang lypa, ki peit bad ki sam.

Mission.libraryPointDescription: Ka kam jingkylla ktien jong bun phew snem, da ki lok ha ka kam mission kiba ngi shaniah, ka la tei ia ka thup kaba don hajar hajar ki ktien, khnang ba ki briew ki lah ban shem ia ka khana jong U Jisu ha ka ktien kaba poi jylliew tam sha ka dohnud jong ki.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Ban rah ia ki sur ba la shaniah sha ki rukom ba thymmai
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Ngi dang tei thymmai ia ka rukom ba la ïathuh ia ki khana jong ka Khubor Bha lyngba ki dur, da kaba ïasnoh ia ki jingkylla ktien ba la shaniah bad ki rukom ba mynta, khnang ba ka khubor ka lah ban ïaid laitluid lyngba ki jaka, ki riti bad ki skrin.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Ka long kham ban ka thup. Ka dei ka kynhun ba trei na bynta ka kam mission.
Mission.teamPointDescription: Jesus Film Project ka dei ka kynhun na ka pyrthei baroh, jong ki nongkylla ktien, ki nongtrei media, ki nongpynbeit bad ki nongshna, kiba pynlong ia ka jingtip jong bun phew snem ha ka kam mission, ban long ki tiar na bynta kito kiba shna ia ki synran ha baroh ki jaka.
Mission.nextStepsTitle: Ka jaka na bynta ki kyrdan ba bud
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Ban ïasnoh ia ki nongpeit bad ki lad ba shisha ha ka jingïaid mynsiem jong ki, ban iarap ia ki ban shim ia ka kyrdan ba bud sha ka jingïalang, sha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid, lane sha ka kam mission.
Mission.mediaLibraryTitle: Ka thup media ban pyntip ia ka Khubor Bha
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Ka thup media Khristan kaba heh, bad hajar hajar ki video, ki film bad ki jingiarap ha bun ki ktien, na bynta ka kam jong U Blei bad ka jingpyntip ia ka Khubor Bha ha ka pyrthei baroh.
Mission.ministryToolsTitle: Ki tiar digital na bynta ki kynhun mission
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ka jingsumar video, ka jingsam ia ki video bad ki jingthoh, ka jingïasnoh bad ki nongpeit, bad ki jingtip shaphang ki nombar, kiba la shna ban iarap ia ki kynhun mission ban poi sha kham bun ki briew.
Mission.inviteHeadline: Iarap ban tei ia {accent} jong ki tiar mission
Mission.inviteBody: Ngi khot ia ki nongtrei, ki nongshna bad ki lok ban pyndonkam nyngkong. Pyrshang shuwa ia ki tiar thymmai, ai ia ki jingmut jong phi, bad iarap ban pynlong ia ki tiar kiba la shna na bynta ka kam mission ba shisha.
